decision: Accept two agreeing original captures. Add a separate legacy-shape/repeated-UID fixture without replacing the accepted main trace. Inputs use fixed plain item records and a seeded command stream; no ambient forge randomness. Normal verification never regenerates expected results.
boundaryDecisions: Successful plans own coordinate objects, including unchanged addresses; arbitrary extension fields remain shallow.
Opaque storage keys are own properties; duplicate or empty keys fail explicitly.
Definitions bound pages to 256 and boards to 4096 cells; costs must remain finite and within the safe numeric range.
